Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Update PhotonVision pose estimation and downgrade PhotonLib to v2025.3.1

Vision system changes:
- Downgraded PhotonLib from v2026.0.1-beta to v2025.3.1 to match PhotonVision version on Raspberry Pi
- Removed setReferencePose\(\) calls \(deprecated in newer versions\)
- Updated pose estimation to use direct update\(\) method with MULTI_TAG_PNP_ON_COPROCESSOR strategy
- Added comprehensive debug logging to track target detection and pose calculation
- Implemented first-tag detection logic to reset odometry on initial AprilTag sighting
- Configured to continuously update odometry with vision measurements after first detection

Other changes:
- Removed Lift subsystem and related commands \(no longer used\)
- Updated PathPlanner auto configurations
- Various simulation and Glass configuration updates

Known issue: PhotonVision v2025.3.1 with 3D mode enabled may not publish individual target data.
Next step: Test disabling 3D mode or upgrade PhotonVision to v2026 for better target publishing.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
